name: CLI Knowledge Operations
statement: A developer stores knowledge, queries it back, searches for content, creates relationships between claims, and generates context summaries — all from the terminal using documented CLI commands.
successCriteria: limen remember --subject 'entity:test:demo' --predicate 'test.value' --value 'hello' returns JSON with claimId and confidence
limen recall --subject 'entity:test:demo' returns JSON array of beliefs including the remembered claim
limen recall with --minConfidence, --limit, and --includeSuperseded filters correctly
limen forget --claimId <id> returns JSON confirming retraction
limen forget --claimId <id> --reason incorrect uses the specified retraction reason
limen connect --from <id1> --to <id2> --type supports returns JSON confirming relationship
limen reflect --entries '[{"category":"finding","statement":"test"}]' returns JSON with stored count and claimIds
limen reflect --file entries.json reads entries from file and processes them
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen remember without --subject, --predicate, or --value produces non-JSON error or crashes
limen forget without --claimId produces non-JSON error or crashes
limen connect without --from, --to, or --type produces non-JSON error or crashes
limen reflect with invalid JSON in --entries crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen forget with nonexistent claimId crashes instead of returning JSON error
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
